mapper.select: select uuufg.favorites_goods_id from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_favorites_goods uuufg where user_id = #{userId} and common_id = #{commonId}

user_id = #{paraMap.userId} AND gc.shop_status = 3 GROUP BY uuufg.goods_id
ORDER BY favorites_goods_time DESC

select uuufg.favorites_goods_id,uuufg.user_id,uuufg.goods_id,uuufg.common_id,uuufg.favorites_goods_time from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_favorites_goods uuufg left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on uuufg.common_id = gc.common_id where user_id = #{userId} and gc.shop_status=3 GROUP BY uuufg.goods_id ORDER BY favorites_goods_time DESC

select uuufs.favorites_shop_id,uuufs.user_id,uuufs.shop_id,uuufs.shop_name, uuufs.shop_logo,uuufs.favorites_shop_time from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_favorites_shop uuufs where user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY shop_id ORDER BY favorites_shop_time DESC
